proof_0289.moves: A definitional simp lemma: the object part of the functor sending a right resolution in a localizer morphism to a left resolution of the opposite localizer morphism is literally the unop of the given data. The proof is rfl - pure definitional unfolding, no mathematical step.

proof_0290.moves: Show the gcd of a set of naturals divides every element of the additive submonoid generated by that set, by induction on the closure: the generators are handled by the already-proved divisibility on members, zero by dvd_zero, and the additive step by dvd_add.

proof_0291.moves: Simp lemma saying that the underlying multilinear map of the continuous multilinear map produced by ofSubsingleton (the equivalence with continuous linear maps when the index type is a subsingleton) is the expected one. Proved by rfl - the content is definitional unfolding of a bundled structure, not a mathematical step.

proof_0292.moves: A wrapper lemma: unfold the Raw tree map to its internal Impl representation, extract the well-formedness witness from the Raw.WF hypothesis, and apply the corresponding Impl-level lemma. No new mathematics.

proof_0293.moves: Nonempty of the coercion-to-sort of a finset is equivalent to the finset being nonempty; this is exactly the general subtype fact Nonempty {x // p x} ↔ ∃ x, p x specialized to membership in the finset.

proof_0294.moves: Pure wrapper: HashMap is a thin layer over DHashMap with a constant value family, so unfold to the inner DHashMap and apply the corresponding DHashMap lemma verbatim.

proof_0295.moves: Wrapper/transport: a subarray's for-in loop agrees with the for-in over its toArray, obtained by specializing the general slice-level forIn_toArray lemma to the subarray iterator. The rest is instance plumbing for the iterator and the Id monad.

proof_0296.moves: Wrapper: unwrap the raw hash map to the underlying dependent raw hash map, pass along the well-formedness witness via WF.out, and invoke the DHashMap.Raw version of getKeyD_insertIfNew.

proof_0297.moves: Componentwise simp lemma: the zero-th component of the natural transformation threeδ₂Toδ₁ between two composable-arrow diagrams is the stated map. Proved by rfl - it just reads off the definition of the transformation at index 0.

proof_0298.moves: Wrapper: package the DHashMap's inner raw map together with its well-formedness/size-positivity witness into the Raw₀ subtype and apply the Raw₀-level getKey_insert_self lemma. The whole content is transporting across the bundling.

proof_0299.moves: Build the ContinuousStar instance on the multiplicative opposite: star on Mᵐᵒᵖ is op ∘ star ∘ unop, so continuity follows by composing continuity of unop, continuity of star on M, and continuity of op.

proof_0300.moves: Injectivity of the map from valuation subrings to local subrings: from an equality of the associated local subrings, take the underlying subring of both sides (congrArg), then use injectivity of a valuation subring's underlying subring.

proof_0301.moves: Computes the forward-map component of the left unitor in the Dialectica category: the composite involving the terminal-object projection and prod.lift collapses, so one rewrites with prod.comp_lift, terminal.comp_from and comp_id until only prod.snd remains. Essentially a chain of categorical-product identities.

proof_0302.moves: Rotating a list by its own length gives the list back: rewrite rotate' n as drop n ++ take n (valid since n ≤ length, discharged by le_rfl), then drop_length gives [] and take_length gives the whole list, so [] ++ l = l.

proof_0303.moves: A constant function is continuous within a set at a point: take global continuity of the constant map and weaken it to continuity within a set at a point.

proof_0304.moves: Characterize when a family of finsets is contained in powersetCard n univ: push the containment down to a universally quantified membership statement (forall_congr'), then rewrite each membership using mem_powersetCard_univ, i.e. membership means having card n.

proof_0305.moves: Simp lemma naming the inverse functor of the self-duality equivalence of the category of Boolean algebras. Proved by rfl - it just projects a field out of the equivalence as constructed.

proof_0306.moves: A comma category has finite limits when the two functors preserve finite limits: apply the HasFiniteLimits constructor, which reduces to giving HasLimitsOfShape J for each small finite category J, and each such instance is already available by typeclass inference from the general comma-limits construction.

proof_0307.moves: Delegation: countBefore for a BEq-decidable equality is the special case of the predicate version countPBefore, so the zero case follows directly from countPBefore_zero.

proof_0308.moves: minKey? of an ordered tree-map implementation is none exactly when the map is empty: transport minKey? to the list model (using the WF ordering hypothesis), apply the list-level minKey?_eq_none_iff_isEmpty, and translate list emptiness back to the tree's isEmpty.

proof_0309.moves: Translation invariance of the uniformity under an additive group action: every element of an additive group is an additive unit, so the general statement for additive units applies.

proof_0310.moves: Pure delegation: a raw hash set is a raw hash map with Unit values, so get? on the empty set is the getKey?_empty lemma for raw hash maps.

proof_0311.moves: Two consecutive half-open intervals Ico a b and Ico b c are disjoint: by disjoint_left, take x in both, mem_Ico gives x < b from the first and b ≤ x from the second, which contradict each other.

proof_0312.moves: Dropping n elements from take n l leaves nothing: rewrite with drop_take, which turns it into take (n - n) (drop n l), then n - n = 0 by Nat.sub_self and take 0 is nil.
